# secobserve_api_configuration (List Resource)

Lists the API configurations of one SecObserve product. `api_key` and `basic_auth_password` are sensitive, so generated configuration has them as null: fill them in before the first apply.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Emits import blocks and configuration for the API configurations of one product.
list "secobserve_api_configuration" "all" {
  provider = secobserve

  config {
    # A .tfquery.hcl cannot reference resources; use the product id.
    product = 12
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `product` (Number) Id of the product whose objects to list.
